name: Elevated Arcana (Monster)
body:
Prerequisites(s): At least one racial Hit Die, spell-like or psi-like abilities from racial Hit Dice.

Benefit(s): Add your Hit Dice from class levels to the caster or manifester levels of any spell-like or psi-like abilities you possess as a result of your racial Hit Dice.
